title: Forever Done
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：forever　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 forever 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Forever, in 1985 the observer remembered the lens at the dome, and everybody in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the observer had ② forever remembered the lens, and nobody had asked a single question. The observer had come to the observatory two nights earlier, and spoke little of the observatory he had left behind him.

The log for November 1979 puts it plainer. The lens was ③ forever grateful, and the assistant who kept it had ④ forever noted it twice before the winter came; nothing in the observatory was ever done forever in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else. He remembered the lens ⑤ forever before dawn, and nobody in the observatory doubted it; of all who remembered it that night, he remembered it ⑥ forever on the same day. He was not a man who explained himself, and the observatory had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the lens be noted ⑦ forever every night, and that whoever did it be ⑧ forever careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done forever.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995 she remembered the lens ⑨ forever on the same day when nobody else would, and ⑩ Forever, she said in 1997, that was the part the observatory never forgot; the log still speaks forever of it. She kept the lens in the same dome for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the observatory never forgot how forever it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 永远（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had forever remembered …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 永远（修饰形容词：forever grateful）
C. adv. 长久（评注性状语，置于句首：Forever, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 长久（修饰过去分词：had forever noted it）
E. adv. 永远（句末状语：… forever before dawn）
F. adv. 永远（句末状语：… forever on the same day，第 6 处）
G. adv. 长久（被动结构中的中位状语：be noted forever）
H. adv. 长久（修饰形容词：be forever careful about the whole business）

answers.why: forever 意为“永远”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Forever, in 1985 …。
forever 意为“永远”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had forever remembered the lens。
forever 意为“永远”，此处修饰形容词 grateful（感激）：was forever grateful。
forever 意为“长久”，此处修饰过去分词 noted：had forever noted it twice。
forever 意为“永远”，此处置于句末修饰动词：remembered the lens forever before dawn。
forever 意为“永远”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 夜晚, he did it forever on the same day。
forever 意为“长久”，被动结构 be noted forever 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
forever 意为“长久”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be forever careful about the whole business。
forever 意为“永远”，1995 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次记住那件小小的镜片，副词置于动词之后。
forever 意为“长久”，母亲 1997 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Forever, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，观测员长久在圆顶记住那件小小的镜片；观测站里人人都说那是头一回。（Forever, …）
雨季到来之前，观测员已经永远记住那件小小的镜片。（had forever remembered …）
那件小小的镜片当时永远感激。（forever grateful）
保管它的那位助手在入冬前已经长久把它记过两回。（had forever noted it）
叔叔永远记住那件小小的镜片，观测站里没有一个人怀疑。（… forever …）
在那个夜晚里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最永远。（the most forever of all of them）
answers: Forever, in 1985 the observer remembered the lens at the dome.
Before the November rains the observer had forever remembered the lens.
The assistant who kept it had forever noted it twice before the winter came.
He remembered the lens forever before dawn, and nobody in the observatory doubted it.
Of all who did it that night, he did it forever on the same day.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 forever 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Forever, in 1985 the observer remembered the lens, and nobody forgot it.
Before the November rains the observer had forever remembered the lens.
The lens was forever grateful, or so the log says.
The assistant had forever noted it twice before the winter came.
My mother remembered the lens forever on the same day when nobody else would.
Forever, the observatory never forgot that part of the story.
